jobs.title: HR Manager
jobs.description:
\*Applicants who do not meet one of the above eligibility requirements will not be considered for this position.\*

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\#\#\# 1\. Employee Management

\* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records.

\* Manage employee onboarding and offboarding processes.

\* Maintain employment contracts, job descriptions, and other HR documentation.

\* Monitor employee information and ensure records are properly maintained.

\* Support employees with general HR\-related queries.

\#\#\# 2\. Right to Work \& Compliance

\* Assist with conducting and maintaining \*Right to Work checks\* for employees.

\* Ensure relevant employee documentation is collected and securely maintained.

\* Keep HR records organised and updated for compliance purposes.

\* Follow company HR procedures and applicable UK employment requirements.

\* Maintain confidentiality when handling employee information.

\#\#\# 3\. HR Administration

\* Maintain the employee master tracker and HR database.

\* Prepare and organise HR documents when required.

\* Keep track of employee joining dates, employment details, holidays, and other relevant information.

\* Assist with payroll\-related HR information and ensure employee records are accurate.

\* Coordinate with management and other departments regarding HR requirements.

\#\#\# 4\. Recruitment Support

\* Assist with preparing job descriptions and vacancy information.

\* Support the recruitment and onboarding process.

\* Coordinate interviews and communication with candidates when required.

\* Ensure necessary documentation is completed before an employee starts work.

\#\#\# 5\. Employee Communication

\* Act as a point of contact for general HR\-related matters.

\* Communicate professionally with employees and management.

\* Handle HR queries in a timely and professional manner.

\* Ensure important HR updates and information are communicated clearly.

\#\#\# 6\. HR Policies \& Procedures

\* Assist in implementing and maintaining company HR policies.

\* Ensure employees are aware of relevant workplace policies and procedures.

\* Help management maintain proper HR documentation and processes.

\* Identify gaps in HR administration and recommend improvements.

\#\# Required Skills \& Experience

The successful candidate should have:

\* \*Excellent verbal and written communication skills\*

\* Good understanding of HR administration and employee management

\* Strong organisational and time\-management skills

\* Ability to work independently while working remotely

\* Good attention to detail

\* Professional approach when dealing with employees and management

\* Ability to maintain confidentiality

\* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office/Google Workspace

\* Ability to maintain accurate records and HR documentation

\* Basic understanding of UK employment practices and HR procedures is preferred

\* Previous experience in an HR, HR administration, recruitment, or people\-management role is preferred

\#\# Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

\* Professional and reliable

\* Confident in communication

\* Well organised and detail\-oriented

\* Proactive and able to take responsibility

\* Comfortable working independently from home

\* Good at handling confidential information

\* Able to manage multiple HR tasks and deadlines

\* Friendly, approachable, and professional when communicating with employees

\#\# Working Arrangement

\*Working Hours:\* 20 hours per week

\*Employment Type:\* Part\-Time

\*Work Location:\* Remote / Work From Home

\*Location:\* UK\-based candidate required

\*Working Pattern:\* To be discussed and agreed during the recruitment process.

The successful candidate must be able to communicate effectively during agreed working hours and attend online meetings when required.

\#\# Eligibility \& Right to Work

Applicants must be able to demonstrate that they have the appropriate right to work in the UK and must hold \*one of the following\*:

\*British Passport \| UK ILR \| EU Settled Status\*

Proof of status/right to work will be required as part of the recruitment process.

\#\# What We Offer

\* Flexible \*part\-time working arrangement\*

\* \*20 hours per week\*

\* Work\-from\-home opportunity

\* Professional and supportive working environment

\* Opportunity to take responsibility for HR operations

\* Long\-term opportunity based on performance and business requirements

\#\# How to Apply

If you meet the eligibility requirements and have the required HR and communication skills, please send your \*CV along with a brief introduction\* highlighting your HR experience and current UK immigration/right\-to\-work status.

\*Only candidates who meet the stated UK eligibility requirements will be considered.\*

Pay: £13\.51 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 per week

Work Location: Remote
